C1447.title: Replay Attacks and Defenses Against Cross-Shard Consensus in Sharded Distributed Ledgers
C1447.summary: This academic paper investigates cross-shard replay attacks in sharded distributed ledgers, highlighting account-based blockchains like Ethereum as common application scenarios. It directly addresses the problem of replay attacks in cross-chain or sharded contexts as defined in risk taxonomies.
